sql: SELECT r.pmid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*49\.6[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20863951' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%49.6%' LIMIT 5
